Subject: Request: per-1M IO token rates + model list (pilot)

Hi Stephanie,

Quick intro — I run product at Northbridge Health. We’re evaluating hosted inference for a clinical documentation assistant pilot (roughly 1M–5M tokens/month initially, expected to grow to ~15M within 6 months if pilot looks good).

Can you send: 1) standard per-1M token pricing broken out by input vs. output, 2) current list of supported models (and any differences in IO rates), and 3) how you structure discounts for committed volumes / 12-month reserved tiers?

We also have a short requirements doc attached (northbridge_requirements_v1.pdf) — particularly interested in latency SLOs for short-chat flows and whether you offer trial credits for a proof-of-concept.

Thanks — if easier we can set up a 30m call next week.

Alex

Great, thanks. Target pilot start: July 10. Procurement note: standard Northbridge terms (we need an executed NDA + PO; prefer net-45 invoicing for pilots if possible). I’ve attached a short procurement checklist in the requirements doc but procurement@northbridge.ai can coordinate on contract language.

Alex
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@northbridge.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood baseline IO rates + commitment options (Northbridge)

Hi Alex / team — attaching the short rate sheet (redwood_rate_sheet_v2.xlsx) and a one-pager summary below. Attachment contains per-1M token IO rates by model family and a sample commitment ladder. Key points:

- Baseline hosted (on-demand) rates (per 1M tokens):
  • small-low-latency models: input $0.55 / output $0.85
  • general-purpose large models: input $0.90 / output $1.45
  • high-context/longer-seq variants: input $1.60 / output $2.40

- Pilot discount / trial credits: We can provide $5k in trial credits upon NDA execution. Pilot PO terms: net-45 acceptable for pilots up to $25k.

- Commitment ladder (examples):
  • 3-month commit (>=5M tokens/month): 8% discount vs on-demand
  • 6-month commit (>=10M tokens/month): 14% discount + free access to one dedicated performance workshop
  • 12-month commit (>=20M tokens/month): 22% discount + ability to reserve burst capacity and a 30% discount on a one-time Quantization optimization assessment

- Models: current hosted catalog (summary):
  • Redwood-Lite-llm (low-latency, 8k context) — recommended for short clinical chat
  • Redwood-Std-llm (balanced cost/quality, 32k context)
  • Redwood-Long-llm (64k context, higher token rates)
  • Open variants (compatibility): Mistral-Base, Llama2-70B-Chat (quantized builds) — availability may affect IO pricing depending on hosting profile

Notes on IO split: output tokens are typically charged higher due to generation costs. We price by actual billed tokens (input + output measured separately) and show both lines on invoices.

If the pilot stays within your $12k–$20k budget for month 1, the baseline on-demand rates above would apply unless you take a short-term commit to get the pilot discount + credits.

Next steps:
- If that looks reasonable, sign NDA and we’ll issue $5k credits + schedule a 30m technical sync with Aditya.
- If procurement prefers PO first, procurement@northbridge.ai can send the PO and we’ll attach it to the deal.

—Ben Carter
Principal Pricing Strategist, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodai.com

Looking forward — Alex
